vocabulary_gaps: No video-link protocol exists. The factory-attached camera coax is internal to this one-module kit, so it is not exposed as an interface; if the camera and transmission module are ever split into separate modules it needs a 'video_link' protocol (or custom + trait). The goggles downlink is modelled as generic 'rf' transceiver with band/latency in a performance trait; DRC cannot check DJI O4 vs O3/analog goggle compatibility.
Antenna port uses 'rf' transceiver + connectorTrait; there is no RF-connector protocol/params (connector family, band) for DRC to match antennas.

BoltPattern assumes coplanar holes. The camera lens mount has 2 side holes per side (16.00 mm apart) on faces 14.00 mm apart; modelled as a 16.00 x 14.00 rectangle with a note. A 'side_mount' shape or camera-width parameter would let frames check micro/nano camera bay width.
